claims.text: Indexing is explicitly secondary to the append-only operational log.

claims.text: Keep the main path alive, but leave evidence for operators debugging an enabled index instead of swallowing every failure invisibly.

claims.text: Use it to recover TODOs after token limits, crashes, or interrupted agent runs.

claims.text: If report.get('bridge_status') == 'failed' and not todos: todos = ['Inspect failed bridge report and retry if needed.']
claims.why: The code implements exactly this logic.
The subcommand 'add' is created with a summary argument.
